mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pay_Clause as conPayClause, c1.C_Name as fpdPayeeName, mn.* from Fund_Plan_Dtl mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Fpd_Payee_Id left join Fund_Plan fp on mn.Fp_Id = fp.id where mn.Fp_Id = #{id} and ((fp.Fp_Type='01' and (mn.Fpd_Type is not null and mn.Fpd_Type!='02')) or (fp.Fp_Type='01' and mn.Fpd_Type='01') or (fp.Fp_Type='01' and mn.Fpd_Type is null) or ((fp.Fp_Type is null or fp.Fp_Type='') and mn.Fpd_Type is null) or ((fp.Fp_Type is null or fp.Fp_Type='') and mn.Fpd_Type='01')) order by mn.Fpd_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pay_Clause as conPayClause, c1.C_Name as fpdPayeeName, mn.* from Fund_Plan_Dtl mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Fpd_Payee_Id left join Fund_Plan fp on mn.Fp_Id = fp.id where mn.Fp_Id = #{id} and (mn.Fpd_Type='02' or fp.Fp_Type='02') order by mn.Fpd_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pay_Clause as conPayClause, c1.C_Name as fpdPayeeName, mn.* from Fund_Plan_Dtl mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Fpd_Payee_Id left join Fund_Plan fp on mn.Fp_Id = fp.id where mn.Fp_Id = #{id} and (mn.Fpd_Type='03' or fp.Fp_Type='03') order by mn.Fpd_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, dep.D_Name as dName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Fund_Plan mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.C_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Department dep on mn.D_Id = dep.D_Id left join SYS_File f on f.Fileid = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update Fund_Plan fp set fp.Fp_Demand_Final=(select sum(Fpd_Demand_Final) from Fund_Plan_Dtl where Fp_Id = fp.id), fp.Fp_Demand_Total_Final=(select sum(Fpd_Demand_Total_Final) from Fund_Plan_Dtl where Fp_Id = fp.id), fp.Fp_Demand_Ratio_Total_Final= (select sum(d1.Fpd_Demand_Total_Final) / (select sum(con.Con_Money_Total) from Con_Contract con left join Fund_Plan_Dtl) from Fund_Plan_Dtl d1 where Fp_Id = fp.id) where fp.Id = #{id}
